message.content: In December, Los Angeles typically enjoys mild, Mediterranean‑climate weather. The average daytime high is about **15 °C (59 °F)**, while nighttime lows hover around **10 °C (50 °F)**. Overall, the monthly mean temperature usually falls in the **12–14 °C (54–57 °F)** range. These averages can vary slightly from year to year, but LA generally stays comfortably cool rather than cold during December.
